name: MPC Template Chooser
author: Elsewave
summary: Replaces Demos on the New Project screen with templates from /Templates on each drive. Installs a startup hook that rewrites /sdcard/Demos/NewProjectDialog.json. Requires Open MPC boot-reload and MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. Tested on MPC X. Gen 2 testers wanted (see GitHub README).
